link.description: This network lets only players with a linked Minecraft account use the dashboard. Join the network, then enter your player name.
link.noAccess: Your role gives you no access to this network's dashboard. Ask an owner for one.

overview.eula: Servers will not start until an owner accepts the Minecraft EULA.

groups.emptyDescription: Create a proxy group and a lobby to let players in.

overview.maintenanceDescription: Only players with the bypass permission can join, and everyone else is disconnected. The autoscaler pauses until maintenance ends.

players.empty: The history fills in once the controller has sampled for a few minutes.
players.title: Players online

reasons.STATIC: A static group keeps its one server

servers.title: Servers

palette.placeholder: Search or go to a page

empty.filteredDescription: Clear the filters or search for another name.

request.description: One more server of the group starts as soon as the controller gets to it.
